welcome:
Welcome to the SSH CLI Playground.
You are on a jumpbox with access to multiple servers.
Type commands to explore key-based auth, tunnelling, and remote access.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Set Up Key-Based Auth and Config

steps.instruction: First, generate an Ed25519 SSH key pair for secure authentication.
Verify the key pair was created. List your .ssh directory.
The private key must not be readable by others. Set correct permissions.
Copy your public key to the app server to enable passwordless login.
Test that key-based login works — connect to the app server.
Now set up an SSH config to create shortcuts. View the current config.
Scan the db server's host key and add it to known_hosts before first connection.
Start the SSH agent and add your key so you don't type the passphrase every time.
A colleague reports they can't SSH to app-server-02. Start with a verbose connection to see what's failing.
The verbose output shows a host key mismatch. Check the known_hosts entry for that server.
The server was recently rebuilt — the old host key is stale. Remove it.
Fetch the new host key from the rebuilt server.
Try connecting again. This time it fails with 'Permission denied (publickey)'. Check what keys the agent has loaded.
No keys loaded. Add the private key to the agent.
The server is behind a firewall. Use the jumpbox as a proxy jump to reach it.
You need to access the app's web UI on port 8080 on app-server-02. Set up a local port forward.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  ssh [user@host]                — Connect to a remote host
  ssh -v / -vv / -vvv           — Verbose / debug connection
  ssh -J [jumphost]             — Proxy jump through a bastion
  ssh -L / -R / -D              — Port forwarding (local/remote/dynamic)
  ssh -o [option]               — Pass config options inline
  ssh-keygen                    — Generate or manage SSH keys
  ssh-copy-id                   — Copy public key to a server
  ssh-add / ssh-agent           — Manage keys in the agent
  ssh-keyscan                   — Fetch host keys from servers
  scp                           — Secure copy files over SSH
  sftp                          — Interactive secure file transfer
  cat ~/.ssh/config             — View SSH client configuration
  ls -la ~/.ssh/                — List SSH directory contents
  chmod                         — Set file permissions

  scenario                      — Start a guided lab
  clear                         — Clear the terminal
  help                          — Show this help
